main.description: List the CIDs of blobs referenced by an account's records within a permissioned space, optionally since some revision of that repo. This is a boundary-scoped read of blobs this service holds. It is a Stratos method, not the upstream com.atproto.space.listBlobs of a similar name. It is callable with standard user auth (the caller must be a member of the space) or with a space credential for that space (for syncing services). Blobs behind permissioned records are never enumerated by an unauthenticated endpoint.

space.description: The space's URI (at:space/{did}/{type}/{skey}). This is a space URI in the form above; upstream's space-ref format (atproto#5187) is expected to adopt it. Declared as a plain string until @atproto/lexicon supports a matching format. Its space DID must equal this service's DID.

repo.description: The DID of the account whose blobs to list.

since.description: Optional revision of the repo to list blobs since.

errors.name: RepoNotFound
errors.description: The requested account has no repo on this service.

errors.name: UnknownSpace
errors.description: The requested space URI is malformed or its space DID does not match this service's DID.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The caller is not admitted to the requested space (not a member, or the presented credential targets a different space).
